system.description:
ARCHIVIST SECRET SHADOW UTILITY
Archivist Specialist Spell
Cast 10 minutes (material, verbal)
Targets One written work containing no more than 20 pages
Duration 24 hours

You conceal the true contents of a written work beneath magically substituted text.
When casting the spell, compose or designate the false wording that will appear in place of the original. Anyone reading the affected pages sees only this substitute text. The original writing is neither erased nor physically altered.
You may designate up to six creatures when casting the spell. Those creatures perceive the original text normally.
Sense Magic can reveal that the document is magically affected but does not reveal the concealed writing. Successfully Counteracting Hidden Doctrine exposes the original text.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Affect up to 100 pages.
+2 PP: Increase the duration to 1 week.
+4 PP: The duration becomes unlimited until Counteracted or dismissed.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
